technical.summary: ABT shows overbought conditions with breakout signals but lacks trend confirmation and MACD divergence; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 28 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.
